name: Rose Canyon lake lots at the end of Rose Canyon Rd
basis: Munchkinland page: drive to the end of the Rose Canyon road and park in one of the large lots; trail starts behind the snack bar. Matched by position to the westernmost lot of the Rose Canyon cluster; exact lot of the several there is uncertain.

name: Marshall Gulch picnic area lot, end of Summerhaven road
basis: Aspen Trail Boulders page: drive to the end of the road past Summerhaven and park; walls within 15 min. Peters Cluster text: reached from Marshall Gulch parking. Matched by position to the lot at the end of the road near Marshall Gulch.

name: Marshall Gulch picnic area lot, end of Summerhaven road
basis: Wilderness of Rocks page: take Mt Lemmon Hwy through Summerhaven to the picnic/parking area at Marshall Gulch, then Marshall Gulch trail ~1.2 mi to the Wilderness of Rocks trail. Matched by position; lot ~2.9 km from area coordinate.
